FAQs:

When does Bad Monkey season 2 premiere?
Bad Monkey season 2 premieres December 2 on Apple TV.

Watch Bad Monkey on Apple TV.

Who stars in Bad Monkey?
Bad Monkey stars Vince Vaughn, L. Scott Caldwell, Rob Delaney, Meredith Hagner, Natalie Martinez, Alex Moffat, Michelle Monaghan, Ronald Peet and Jodie Turner-Smith, with special guest star John Ortiz and guest stars Zach Braff, Ashley Nicole Black, Scott Glenn and Charlotte Lawrence.

Who created Bad Monkey?
Bad Monkey is developed by executive producer and showrunner Bill Lawrence, the award-winning creator and producer behind Apple TV comedies including Ted Lasso and Shrinking. Vince Vaughn also serves as star and executive producer.

What is Bad Monkey about?
Bad Monkey is a comedy based on Carl Hiaasen’s New York Times bestselling novel about Andrew Yancy, played by Vince Vaughn, a former Miami police detective who is now working as a health inspector in the Florida Keys. After tourists fish a human arm out of the water, Yancy sees a chance to prove it was murder and win his way back onto the force, but first he has to get through a cast of Floridian oddballs and one bad monkey.

What genre is Bad Monkey?
Bad Monkey is a comedy, crime comedy and Florida-set mystery series.

What are other shows and movies like Bad Monkey?
Shows and movies with a similar feel to Bad Monkey include Apple TV comedies like Ted Lasso, Shrinking, The Studio, Loot, Platonic, The Afterparty and Acapulco, as well as offbeat crime comedies and sun-soaked mysteries like The White Lotus, Only Murders in the Building, Search Party, Burn Notice, Get Shorty, Fletch, The Nice Guys, Kiss Kiss Bang Bangand other comedic mysteries about crime, chaos and eccentric characters.

item.title: [Netflix Anime] Fool Night | Official Trailer | Netflix Anime
item.description:
Transfloration — a technology that implants seeds into the bodies of those near death, transforming them into plants. It is the desperate measure humanity has chosen to ensure its survival.

In a distant future where thick clouds cover the sky, trapping Earth in constant winter and night, most of the planet’s vegetation has withered away. Facing a serious oxygen shortage, humanity has built a society that relies on the meager amount of oxygen provided by Transfloration.

A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother. However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope.

In their first collaboration, Sunrise and Shaft present "Fool Night",
a highly anticipated anime adaptation of the globally acclaimed manga.
All episodes start streaming on Thursday, November 26, 2026, only on Netflix.

item.title: [HBO Max] The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast | Trailer
item.description:
The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast is coming October 30. Enter the world of DC Super-Villains as writer/director and co-head of DC Studios James Gunn teams up with Jennifer Holland (Emilia Harcourt) and Steve Agee (John Economos, and technically King Shark) for a special one-off episode to answer the question fans keep asking: what is canon?

The Suicide Squad came out before the cinematic DCU existed. Since then, Peacemaker has gotten his own show, and Weasel has joined the Creature Commandos. The trio digs into Harley, Bloodsport, Ratcatcher 2, King Shark, Amanda Waller, and more, with stories from the set, messages from a few friends from The Suicide Squad, and answers to your fan questions.

Whether you’ve watched The Suicide Squad a dozen times or you’re just discovering the movie that kicked off James Gunn’s DC journey, this special is your guide to what counts in the DCU. Stream The Suicide Squad on HBO Max before you tune in.

Two women on opposite sides of the globe, Amanda Woods (Cameron Diaz) and Iris Simpkins (Kate Winslet) find themselves in a similar predicament. Desperate for a change of scenery, the two women meet on the internet and swap houses for the Christmas holiday discovering that a change of address really can change your life.

In Nancy Meyers' The Holiday, a romantic comedy from the director of Something's Gotta Give and What Women Want, two women trade homes only to find that a change of address can change their lives. Iris (Winslet) is in love with a man who is about to marry another woman. Across the globe, Amanda (Diaz), realizes the man she lives with has been unfaithful. Two women who have never met and live 6000 miles apart, find themselves in the exact same place. They meet online at a home exchange website and impulsively switch homes for the holiday. Iris moves into Amanda's L.A. house in sunny California as Amanda arrives in the snow covered English countryside. Shortly after arriving at their destinations, both women find the last thing either wants or expects: a new romance. Amanda is charmed by Iris' handsome brother Graham (Law) and Iris, with inspiration provided by legendary screenwriter Arthur (Wallach), mends her heart when she meets film composer Miles (Black).

item.title: [Palace Films] LA GRADIVA - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas
item.description:
https://www.palacefilms.com.au/la-gradiva © Palace Films

GRAND PRIX WINNER – 2026 CANNES FILM FESTIVAL (Critics' Week)
WINNER - 2026 MELBOURNE INTERNATIONAL FILM FESTIVAL (Bright Horizons)
WINNER - 2026 NEW ZEALAND INTERNATIONAL FILM FESTIVAL (Fresh Competition

Widely heralded as the major discovery of the 2026 Cannes Film Festival, writer/director Marine Atlan’s stunning debut feature follows a class of French high school students on a life-changing excursion to Naples.

As they await their university acceptance letters, a spirited group of teens travels south by train with their Latin teacher, Madame Mercier (a remarkable Antonia Buresi). Among the ruins of Pompeii - where the eruption of Vesuvius froze a civilisation in time - they begin to confront the murky realities of who they are now, and who they are becoming. But the trip proves as emotionally volatile as it is enlightening... gradually consumed by the demands of her role, Mercier struggles to keep her students in line, including the attention-seeking Toni (Colas Quignard), whose unexpected ties to the region hint at deeper currents; his cocky object of affection, James (Mitia Capellier); and Suzanne (Suzanne Gerin), an introspective outsider. As tensions simmer within the group, rivalries, pent-up emotions and betrayals build with mounting intensity. One by one, they are swept up in the region’s overwhelming beauty and their own awakening desires, until they surrender to them completely…

At once sensuous and searching, LA GRADIVA is an immersive journey through the culture and vistas of southern Italy, capturing the fragile threshold between adolescence and adulthood. With striking assurance, Atlan draws deeply naturalistic performances from her cast, rendering each character with empathy, nuance and profound care, their futures resonating well beyond the final frame.

Echoing the impact of such classic films as Peter's Weir's 'Picnic at Hanging Rock', Alice Rohrwacher's 'La Chimera' and Laurent Cantet's 'The Class', the film marks Atlan as an artist of extraordinary talent.

From master director Andrey Zvyagintsev ('Leviathan', 'Elena', 'Loveless'), the powerful new drama MINOTAUR traces the emotional and moral collapse of a Russian businessman under the strain of personal and political upheaval.

Provincial Russia, 2022. In the immediate aftermath of his nation’s invasion of Ukraine, wealthy company CEO Gleb (Dmitriy Mazurov) is compelled to support the war machine, tasked with “volunteering” men from his own workforce for conscription. As the demands of the state close in, so too does his private life begin to fracture. His growing suspicion that his wife Galina (Iris Lebedeva) is having an affair with a young artist is soon confirmed, sending his carefully constructed world into a rapid descent.

Marking his first feature in close to a decade, the now-exiled Zvyagintsev reunites with longtime collaborators cinematographer Mikhail Krichman and production designer Andrey Ponkratov, on a work that stands as a potent continuation of his incisive exploration of power. Both a merciless thriller for our present times and a formidable artistic achievement, MINOTAUR emerges as a pièce de résistance in more ways than one.

Palme d’Or-winning director Koreeda Hirokazu ('Shoplifters', 'Like Father Like Son', 'The Truth') brings his signature humanism to LOOK BACK, a deeply moving adaptation of Tatsuki Fujimoto’s acclaimed 'one-shot' manga about the wild emotional swings of childhood friendship, and the process of finding your voice through art.

Nikaho City, northern Japan. Fourth-grader Fujino enjoys the admiration of her classmates, who delight in the four-panel comics she publishes in the school newspaper. But her confidence is shaken when Kyōmoto. – a reclusive classmate whose social anxiety keeps her from attending school - begins submitting work of extraordinary and superior skill. What starts as quiet rivalry soon evolves into a profound creative partnership, bound by a shared devotion to illustration. As they grow together - and eventually apart - their journey traces the fragile interplay of connection, ambition and regret...

First published on Shonen Jump+ in 2021, Look Back sparked immediate buzz, recording 2.5 million views on its first day. It has sold over 900,000 copies in Japan and has been published in 37 countries worldwide with more than 750,000 copies sold internationally. Koreeda’s adaptation follows Oshiyama Kiyotaka’s 2024 animated feature adaptation of the same name, a critical and box office success that earned a Japan Academy Film Prize for Best Animated Feature, and a nomination for Best Animated Feature (Independent) at the Annie Awards.

item.title: [Palace Films] LA SCALA: THE FORCE OF DESTINY - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas
item.description:
https://www.palacefilms.com.au/la-scala-the-force-of-destiny © Palace Films

OFFICIAL SELECTION - 2025 ROME FILM FEST

Granting to opera what 'The September Issue' gave to fashion, Anissa Bonnefont’s atmospheric new documentary follows 900 artists, staff and technicians at Milan’s legendary opera house Teatro alla Scala over four months as they anxiously work to incarnate a new production of Verdi’s masterpiece “The Force of Destiny” that will premiere as the theatre’s traditional 7 December Opening Night gala.

Milan - and Italy - holds its breath for what is one of the international opera calendar's most prestigious events. The stakes are high: the performance will draw political and cultural elites and be broadcast live to cinemas worldwide, including Australia.

Inside La Scala's creative hive, stage director Leo Muscato readies his vision with the set and costume design teams - as the chorus and orchestra rehearse under maestro Riccardo Chailly, and theatre staff prepare the 250-year-old venue. There's added anticipation with the arrival of the star international cast – among them Anna Netrebko, Brian Jagde, and Ludovic Tézier - set to fill the theatre's hallowed halls with their powerful voices. But with the clock ticking, the tension backstage builds… Will they be ready when the curtain rises?

Filmed with unprecedented access, LA SCALA: THE FORCE OF DESTINY is more than a behind‑the‑scenes chronicle. Beautifully capturing the remarkable endeavour of staging a major new production, the film reveals the passion, apprehension and brilliance of these artists, and celebrates the grandeur and preciousness of the artform. For both newcomers and devoted opera lovers, it’s an invitation to witness the magic of creation on the big screen.

item.description:
http://www.palacefilms.com.au/holy-cannoli © Palace Films

Witty, romantic and smart, the eagerly-awaited new film from beloved Italian satirist Pierfrancesco ‘Pif’ Diliberto ('The Mafia Kills Only In Summer') - adapted from his own bestselling novel - is a hugely entertaining and gently irreverent comedy about love, faith and finding the perfect pastry.

Sicily, present day. Arturo (Pif) is a real estate agent near-infallible at his job, but far less so in love. A creature of habit, Arturo lives alone, is the weak link in his office's five-a-side football team, and nurtures a single, unwavering passion: desserts - the delights and criticisms of which he posts on social media. He especially loves the sciù (Palermo's favourite cream-filled choux buns) from the city's most celebrated pasticceria. His life lights up when he meets the owner’s daughter, the fervently religious Flora (Giusy Buscemi), who's looking to rent a space to open her own patisserie. Falling instantly, hopelessly in love, Arturo is thrust into a world of belief and moral expectation far beyond his comfort zone. To win Flora over, he embellishes his commitment to Catholicism and embarks on an increasingly absurd attempt to live by the gospel, a quest so unlikely it earns him a most unexpected spiritual advisor: the Pope himself.

By turns playful, pointed and cheeky, HOLY CANNOLI channels Pif’s distinctive gift for using comedy to explore the contradictions of contemporary Italian life, in this case as experienced by a soul-searching, sweet-toothed sceptic.

item.description:
© Palace Films

WINNER – 2025 ROME FILM FEST - Best Actress (Trinca)

Loosely inspired by one of the most notorious scandals in modern Italian history, Andrea De Sica's captivatingly wicked satirical parable is set on the wild and beautiful island of Zannone in the Pontine archipelago, where an exorbitantly wealthy marquis (Filippo Timi) holds court. When Elena (Jasmine Trinca) arrives as the wife of one of his weekend guests, the attraction is instantaneous - and the marriage that follows, once both have abandoned their spouses, will draw them both into a by turns tender, sordid and murderous collision between love, eros and reckless privilege.
